description.translate: Four amethyst shards should let me finish the listening apparatus. We will listen first. No ignition, no grand demonstration, and no promises that we understand more than we do. Hand the materials to me one at a time.
There it is. The same interval, quieter than before. Mara Coppersmith may recognize the industrial markings in these records. Find her. Tell her we are rebuilding the evidence, not the engine.
